fusions.name: Pressure Cut
fusions.desc: Fires a thin jet of water that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Bleed Out
fusions.desc: Slides in close and cuts, dealing 16 damage and adding the remaining damage of every affliction on the target. It uses up every one of your afflictions on the target, dealing 60% more for each one.

fusions.name: Slipped Notice
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds, and you move 4% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Wiped Clean
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next strike has 25% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
